required_freeze_additions.title: Deterministic reduction of each channel map to 32 values
required_freeze_additions.why: phase24_exact_implementation_spec.json#router declares pool_width_per_axis = 32 and a closed-form total of 218 (6 x 32 + 10 + 16), but never states the OPERATION that produces 32 values from a C-channel map
required_freeze_additions.must_specify: the exact deterministic map from a C-channel feature grid to 32 values, and whether it is spatial-only (e.g. a fixed spatial pooling to a 32-length axis) or channel-reducing; it must NOT be a trainable projection (trainable_conv_projection_before_pooling is false)

required_freeze_additions.title: ROI-to-feature-grid coordinate mapping convention

required_freeze_additions.must_specify: image->feature scale factor per tap, integer rounding rule (floor/round/ceil), boundary clipping rule, and the empty-ROI defensive behaviour

required_freeze_additions.title: Closed-form definitions of the ten scalar descriptors
required_freeze_additions.why: the primary feature set supplies mapping_kind + English derivation prose only; no equation is frozen
required_freeze_additions.must_specify: for each of the ten scalars: exact formula, input tensor, units, dtype, and the governing threshold ROLE.
